items.title: Shopify is moving from React Native back to Swift and Kotlin
items.author: fnthawar2
items.summary_zh: Shopify 正在把移动应用从 React Native 迁回原生 Swift 和 Kotlin，原文给出的理由是 coding agent 改变了构建移动应用的成本结构。目前披露的信息只有这一句背景，迁移范围和排期等细节尚未公开。
items.summary_en: Shopify is moving its mobile apps from React Native back to native Swift and Kotlin, with the post arguing that coding agents have changed what it costs to build mobile apps twice over. Beyond that framing the summary offers no further detail, so the scope and timeline of the migration aren't known.

items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
items.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
items.author: debpalash
items.summary_zh: VoiceStudio 是完全本地运行的开源语音工具，前身叫 OmniVoice-Studio，内置 16 个 TTS 与 11 个 ASR 引擎，支持 646 种语言的语音克隆、视频配音、听写与有声书制作，覆盖 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Docker。它的本地流程不需要账号、API key 或订阅计费，适合看重隐私与成本的开发者自托管；项目目前正在做 Electron 重写，暂停受理桌面端相关 issue 和 PR。
items.summary_en: VoiceStudio is a fully local, open-source voice toolkit (formerly OmniVoice-Studio) bundling 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines for voice cloning, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation across 646 languages on macOS, Windows, Linux and Docker. The local workflow needs no account, API key or subscription, which suits developers who want self-hosted speech tooling without a usage meter. An Electron rewrite is underway, and desktop-app issues and PRs are on hold.

items.title: Anysite.io
items.description: Build and enrich B2B lists by chatting to your agent
items.summary_zh: Anysite.io 是一款通过和 agent 对话来构建并补充 B2B 线索列表的工具，用户描述目标客户条件即可生成名单并完成数据 enrich，不必手动维护表格。对做海外获客、需要批量整理公司和联系人信息的销售与增长团队比较对口。
items.summary_en: Anysite.io is a Product Hunt tool that builds and enriches B2B prospect lists by chatting with an agent, so you describe the accounts you want instead of filling in spreadsheets by hand. It targets sales and growth teams doing outbound prospecting who need company and contact data assembled quickly.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从 Cursor 切换到 Codex 用了大半个月后写下真实体验：Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的冲击，而 Codex 让他觉得 AI 不再只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级 Agent，形态上更接近下一阶段。适合在 Cursor 与 Codex 之间犹豫的开发者参考。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Codex for roughly half a month, a developer shares his honest take: Cursor was what first made AI-assisted coding feel striking, while Codex comes across less as a coding assistant and more as a full-fledged super Agent, in his view closer to the next stage. Useful for developers weighing the two tools.

items.title: 程序员为干私活腾空间 17 小时删光公司 89TB 数据，获刑五年十个月，暴露出哪些问题？
items.summary_zh: 一名程序员为腾出空间干私活，在 17 小时内删光公司 89TB 数据，最终获刑五年十个月。原文是链接帖，未提供更多细节，但这类案件通常牵出高危权限管理、备份与恢复策略、以及离职或兼职人员操作审计等具体问题。
items.summary_en: A programmer deleted 89TB of company data over 17 hours to free up room for side work and was sentenced to five years and ten months. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available, though cases like this usually raise questions about privileged access control, backup and recovery strategy, and auditing what staff with one foot out the door can do.

items.title: 8点1氪丨创始人及员工被恶意造谣，月之暗面：已报案；25位菲尔兹奖得主就AI侵入数学联合发出警告；智谱宣布融资50亿美元

The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: 两个 Token 就让 Kimi“变成”Claude？前Google DeepMind研究员意外撞上大模型的蒸馏疑云
items.summary_zh: 一位前 Google DeepMind 研究员在实验中发现，只要两个 Token 就能让 Kimi 表现得像 Claude，由此引出对大模型蒸馏的疑问。原帖未提供更多细节，但这件事关系到蒸馏与模型指纹识别，也是判断模型来源、训练数据合规时绕不开的话题。
items.summary_en: A former Google DeepMind researcher found that just two tokens could make Kimi behave like Claude, which led to suspicions about model distillation. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available, though the episode touches on distillation and model fingerprinting, which matter to anyone assessing a model's provenance or training-data compliance.

items.title: [问与答] 港版 iPhone 新 Siri AI 突然用不了变成旧版的 Apple Intelligence AI（彩虹跑马灯）
items.summary_zh: 一位港版 iPhone 17 Pro Max 用户反馈，新 Siri AI 近日突然失效，退回旧的彩虹跑马灯版本；他用的是国行 iCloud 加美区商店，分流规则未改，已把 apple-relay、guzzoni.apple.com 等域名指向美区家宽，常见方法也无效。帖子贴出了完整分流规则却没给出结论，可供排查 Apple Intelligence 可用性时对照。
items.summary_en: A user with a Hong Kong iPhone 17 Pro Max reports that the new Siri AI stopped working in recent days and reverted to the older rainbow-light version, despite an unchanged rule set on a China-mainland iCloud account with a US App Store account, with domains such as apple-relay and guzzoni.apple.com routed to a US home broadband line. The post lists its full routing rules without a conclusion, but it is worth reading if you are debugging Apple Intelligence availability.

items.title: 模型一模一样，Token 却相差 70 倍？三项实测揭开 AI 编程工具的成本黑洞
items.summary_zh: 同一个模型在不同 AI 编程工具里消耗的 Token 数量最多可相差 70 倍，作者用三项实测对比了各工具的成本差异。原帖未提供更多细节，但对按 Token 计费或正在做工具选型的团队来说，这个量级的差距会直接反映在账单上。
items.summary_en: The same model can burn up to 70 times more tokens depending on which AI coding tool wraps it, with three hands-on tests comparing the cost differences across tools. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available, but for teams billed per token or picking tooling, a gap of that size shows up straight on the invoice.

items.title: [分享创造] Chatchuu: 拍一张照，与你的照片里的任何东西聊天
items.summary_zh: Chatchuu 是一款 iOS 应用（App Store id 6775716440），作者称这是自己一个小想法的实现：拍一张照或选一张图，应用会自动识别画面中的物体供你选择，你可以和猫狗、耳机、咖啡、花草等任意对象聊天，对方还会先打招呼。适合想尝鲜图像识别加对话玩法的人，分享中未提及定价或 Android 版本。
items.summary_en: Chatchuu is an iOS app (App Store id 6775716440) whose developer says it grew out of a small personal idea: take or pick a photo, and the app identifies the objects in the frame so you can chat with any of them, from cats and headphones to coffee or plants, with each object greeting you first. It's for people curious about photo recognition plus conversation; no pricing or Android version is mentioned.

items.title: V4.1 Flash全面超越，开发者为何还在喷 DeepSeek：缺的不是能力，是软件工程思维
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 把发往 V4 Pro 的请求在 V4.1 Pro 上线前全部路由到 V4.1 Flash，并按 Flash 价格计费，理由是后者在性能、费用、速度和总用时上全面超过前者，而公告只提前了约一天。开发者不满的正是缺少并行迁移期，建议给旧模型保留独立 model ID 和两周缓冲，因为线上 prompt、工具调用和输出格式都依赖具体模型的行为。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek's Harness team member Cui Tianyi tweeted on 9 September that V4.1 Flash beats V4 Pro across performance, cost, speed and total latency, so all V4 Pro requests are being routed to V4.1 Flash and billed at Flash prices until V4.1 Pro ships. The open-platform notice left roughly one day's notice and no overlap period; developers argue production prompts, QC and tool-calling behaviour are tuned to a specific model, so they want a separate model ID and a two-week migration window.

items.author: u1hcw9nx

items.title: [JetBrains] 吐槽下 jetbrains 的 ai assistant 功能
items.summary_zh: 一位 V2EX 用户吐槽 JetBrains AI Assistant 的 ACP 功能：每个 ACP 插件动辄几百兆甚至上 G，旧版本全部保留且实际无法卸载（图标仍显示 install），还捆绑一堆 node 包；插件甚至不知道当前项目在哪个目录，只会去扫 /c/Users/PC 用户目录，必须手动粘贴完整路径。在设置里配好第三方 API 后也只能用 chat 功能，作者直言这些半成品不如 agent cli、trae、workbuddy 好用。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user complains about JetBrains AI Assistant's ACP feature: each ACP plugin weighs hundreds of megabytes up to a gigabyte, older versions are kept and can't really be removed (the UI still shows an install icon), and they bundle piles of node packages. The assistant doesn't even know the current project directory, scanning the whole user folder instead and forcing hand-pasted paths, and a configured third-party API only unlocks chat. The author calls these half-finished features worse than agent cli, trae or workbuddy.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 掘金一篇面向面试的文章讨论“AI 已能写 80% 的代码，公司为什么还需要你”。作者称 2026 年的技术面试已与两年前不同：过去考手写 Promise、React Fiber 原理，如今面试官默认你会用 AI，考察点随之转移。适合准备面试或负责招聘的开发者，但给出的摘要在此截断，未展开具体答案。
items.summary_en: A Juejin article tackles the interview question "AI can already write 80% of the code, so why does the company still need you?" It contrasts 2026 interviews with those two years ago, when candidates hand-wrote a Promise or explained React Fiber internals; today interviewers assume AI use and probe something else. Useful for developers preparing for interviews or doing the hiring, though the supplied excerpt cuts off before the full argument.

items.title: [CrossBorder] 有人通过爱沙尼亚 e-Residency 开过公司吗？实际运营下来值得吗？
items.summary_zh: 一位已拿到爱沙尼亚 e-Residency 电子证书的 V2EX 用户，想了解用它注册并实际运营公司的真实体验，重点问开户与收款是否顺利、遇到过哪些审核和材料限制。他还想弄清记账、地址服务等每年维护成本以及自己要投入多少精力，尤其关心申请前没想到、运营后才暴露的问题。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user who already holds an Estonian e-Residency digital certificate is asking for firsthand experience running a company through the program. The questions center on how smoothly account opening and payment collection go, what annual costs bookkeeping and address services add up to, and how much personal effort upkeep demands. The focus is on problems that only surface after launch, which is useful for anyone weighing e-Residency for cross-border business.

items.title: 从沙箱到执行边界：蚂蚁 AI Agent 的大规模企业级实践｜QCon上海
items.summary_zh: QCon 上海站定于 2026 年 10 月 22 日至 24 日举办，蚂蚁集团高级技术专家林鑫将在「AI Native 架构」专题分享《从沙箱到执行边界：蚂蚁 AI Agent 的大规模企业级实践》。该分享聚焦企业级 Agent 执行环境在隔离、冷启动、状态保持与大规模调度上的矛盾，认为传统容器和普通 Serverless 已难支撑规模化落地，适合做 Agent 平台与基础设施的工程师。
items.summary_en: QCon Global Software Development Conference Shanghai runs October 22 to 24, 2026, and Ant Group senior technical expert Lin Xin will speak in the AI Native Architecture track with a session titled "From Sandbox to Execution Boundary: Ant's Large-Scale Enterprise AI Agent Practice." The talk addresses the tensions enterprise agent runtimes face around isolation, cold starts, state retention and large-scale scheduling, arguing that traditional containers and plain serverless can no longer carry production-scale agents. It is aimed at engineers building agent platforms and infrastructure.

items.title: JustVugg/colibri
items.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
items.author: JustVugg
items.summary_zh: colibri 是一个纯 C、零依赖的推理引擎，把磁盘、内存与显存当作统一推理层级、按需从磁盘流式加载 experts，从而在消费级或异构硬件上运行 744B 到 2.8T 参数的 MoE 模型，现已支持 GLM、Kimi K3、DeepSeek V4 等九个模型家族。适合想在自有硬件上部署超大 MoE、又不愿引入 Python 依赖栈的开发者。
items.summary_en: colibri is a pure-C, dependency-free inference engine that treats disk, RAM and VRAM as one memory hierarchy and streams experts from disk, letting frontier MoE models of 744B to 2.8T parameters run on consumer or heterogeneous hardware. Nine model families are supported today, including GLM, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4. It targets developers who want to serve very large MoE models on machines they already own.

items.title: [Apple] airpods max 异响
items.summary_zh: 一位 V2EX 用户称自己的 AirPods Max 用了快一年后，右耳出现每秒约两下的「哒哒」异响，想确认是否有人遇到过同类问题。他还提到耳罩虽然能拆下来用洗衣液清洗，但对爱出汗的人来说异味依然明显，并吐槽这款耳机价格偏高。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user says their roughly one-year-old AirPods Max has developed a ticking noise in the right earcup, about two clicks per second, and asks whether others have hit the same issue. They also note that although the cushions can be washed with detergent, they still smell bad for people who sweat heavily, and call the headset overpriced.

items.title: Google Mantis：一款旨在减少误报的基于智能代理的漏洞扫描框架
items.summary_zh: Google 开源了 Mantis，一个覆盖漏洞识别、验证、复现到修复全流程的 AI 代理框架，用来解决传统 AI 代码扫描误报泛滥、真阳性率不足 7% 的问题。它靠批评者、审查者等代理过滤误报，在沙箱中复现验证，并把代码库组织成分层树以节省 85% 的 token，模块化技能套件含 15 种以上工具，支持按阶段混用不同模型。
items.summary_en: Google has open-sourced Mantis, an agent framework that automates the vulnerability lifecycle from identification and validation to reproduction and patching, built to fix the high false-positive rates of earlier AI code scanners, whose true-positive rate sits below 7%. It uses critic and reviewer agents to filter noise, sandboxed reproduction to prove findings, and a codebase-level hierarchical tree that cuts token usage by 85%. Its modular skill suite ships 15-plus tools that can run sequentially or in parallel, with different models chosen per stage.

items.summary_en: A Hacker News post describes accidentally clicking a shady YouTube ad that mimicked an iOS “Storage Full” alert; the author reported it twice and Google still ruled the ad fine, while Gemini flagged its deceptive design in seconds. items.title: Figma 如何利用 AI 代理提升安全性
items.summary_zh: Figma 工程团队公开了其安全 AI 代理的构建细节：系统基于 Panther SIEM，可查询 AWS、GitHub 等 100 多个数据源并自动发起 PR，分诊代理采用类 Claude Opus 模型，历史告警检索依赖 AWS Bedrock、Amazon Kendra、Tines 与 Snowflake。据其披露，复杂告警处理时间缩短约 70%，值班通知减少 20%，代码审查准确率一个月内达到 80%，并发现 100 多个此前未发现的漏洞。团队给出的核心经验是先提升精确率，再追求召回率。
items.summary_en: Figma's engineering team detailed how it built AI agents that help its security team triage alerts, search past incidents and even draft code fixes. Built on Panther SIEM, the system queries AWS, Okta, GitHub, GCP and 100+ other sources and can open pull requests, with a triage agent using a Claude Opus-class model. Complex alert handling time reportedly fell about 70%, on-call notifications by 20%, and code-review accuracy reached 80% within a month.

items.summary_en: Alibaba has open-sourced open-code-review (npm: @alibaba-group/open-code-review), a tool that pairs deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent to post precise line-level comments, backed by a built-in multi-language ruleset covering issues such as NPE. The repo says it is battle-tested at Alibaba's scale, making it worth a look for teams that want automated review wired into CI.

items.title: Read, Don't Write: 重塑大模型评价体系，构建全自动、可进化的“探测式”评测管线｜QCon上海
items.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴高级技术专家孙鹏在 QCon 上海站分享的方案 BoRP 换了个思路做模型评测：不让 LLM 写评语，而是用对比表示提取与 PLS 回归直接读取隐状态里的满意度信号。它把评测成本降低 97%，人类对齐度超过生成式 LLM-as-a-Judge，并已在万亿级流量的 A/B 测试中落地。
items.summary_en: At QCon Shanghai, Alibaba senior engineer Sun Peng presents BoRP (Bootstrapped Regression Probing), an evaluation approach that skips generated critiques entirely: it reads satisfaction signals out of a model's hidden states using contrastive representation extraction and PLS regression. The method cuts evaluation cost by 97%, beats generative LLM-as-a-Judge on human alignment, and is already running in A/B tests at trillion-scale traffic.

items.summary_en: FreeCORE is a community-driven fork of TrueNAS CORE that jumps its baseline from 13.3 straight to FreeBSD 15.0; the stable 15.0-U1 release offers an in-place upgrade path and 15.1 is next. After upstream iXsystems shifted engineering to Debian-based TrueNAS SCALE, FreeCORE restores FreeBSD Jails, bhyve virtual machines and native plugins that had been marked obsolete, which matters to admins running storage on FreeBSD.

items.author: jonifico

items.title: SnailSploit/Claude-Red
items.description: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.
items.author: SnailSploit
items.summary_zh: claude-red 是一个面向 Claude Skills 系统的攻防安全技能库，由 78 个 SKILL.md 文件组成，按 23 个分类覆盖 SQL 注入、shellcode 等具体攻击面，每个文件为 Claude 注入对应领域专家级的红队方法论。项目采用 MIT 协议，适合做渗透测试或红队工作、想把 Claude 当成上下文感知攻击操作员来用的人。
items.summary_en: claude-red is a curated library of offensive-security skills for the Claude Skills system, packaged as 78 SKILL.md files across 23 categories, each priming Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface such as SQL injection or shellcode. Released under MIT, it targets red teamers and pentesters who want Claude to act as a context-aware operator.

items.summary_en: YuE2 is a music generation model from the multimodal-art-projection team that unifies symbolic planning with audio generation, and adds zero-shot covers plus agentic music editing; weights ship as YuE2-3B on Hugging Face. items.title: 三年了，AI为何还没有抢走程序员饭碗？
items.description: AI取代程序员，喊了应该是第三个年头了。 但显然，即使是AI已经迭代到 Claude 5、GPT-6 的当下，很多人想象中的大裁员潮也并没有到来。
items.summary_zh: AI 取代程序员的说法已经持续三年，这篇文章指出，即使 AI 已迭代到 Claude 5、GPT-6 的节点，人们预期的大规模裁员潮也没有发生。讨论点集中在口号式预言和真实开发工作之间的落差，适合做技术人力和 AI 工具评估的读者了解另一面。
items.summary_en: This Chinese tech commentary revisits the three-year-old claim that AI will take programmers' jobs. It argues that even as AI has iterated to Claude 5 and GPT-6, the anticipated wave of mass layoffs still hasn't happened. Useful reading for developers reconsidering 'AI replaces coders' narratives.

items.summary_en: On August 13, DeepSeek open-sourced DeepSeek Harness (dsh), its first agent product, and also released a 20,000-word beginner-friendly tutorial. The release marks DeepSeek's official entry into the agent space, giving developers who want to try dsh a practical starting point and a useful reference for studying how the tool is built.

items.title: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩
items.description: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩？工程化解法详解 前言 你有没有试过用ChatGPT写小说？ 前几章写得挺好，角色鲜明、情节紧凑。但写到30章左右，突然发现：主角的妹妹名字变了，第5章埋的伏笔忘了回收，
items.summary_zh: 文章用 ChatGPT 写长篇示例：开头角色鲜明、情节紧凑，但约 30 章后会出现主角妹妹名字变化、第 5 章伏笔未回收等一致性崩溃；它分析了这类长文崩坏的工程原因，并给出工程化解决思路。适合用大模型做长篇创作的开发者和写作者。
items.summary_en: The post uses a ChatGPT novel as an example: early chapters are vivid and tight, but around chapter 30 continuity collapses—a heroine's sister changes name and a setup from chapter 5 is forgotten. It then explains why this failure happens in long-form AI writing and outlines an engineering-oriented fix, making it relevant for developers and authors producing long texts with LLMs.

items.title: 这个本地模型，让我 token 自由了
items.description: Qwen3.8-27B 把旗舰级 Agent 能力搬进个人电脑，本地运行不花 API 费用，但速度、内存和长任务体验仍有明显门槛。
items.summary_zh: 掘金这篇文章讲的是 Qwen3.8-27B，一个能跑在个人电脑上、不花 API 费用的本地模型，主打把旗舰级 Agent 能力搬到本机。作者也点明代价：速度、内存占用和长任务体验仍有明显门槛，适合愿意折腾本地推理、对响应速度不那么敏感的人。
items.summary_en: The post looks at Qwen3.8-27B, a local model that brings flagship-level agent capability to a personal machine without paying API fees. The author is upfront about the trade-offs: inference speed, memory footprint and long-task experience remain real barriers. It suits developers willing to run local inference who can live with slower responses.

items.title: 为什么跳槽涨薪 30% 的时代彻底结束了？聊聊 2026 前端薪资的天花板
items.description: 前端薪资红利期结束，供需失衡与AI工具普及压缩执行层价值。高薪转向决策层，需具备成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力。
items.summary_zh: 文章称，前端跳槽涨薪 30% 的红利期已结束，2026 年薪资天花板受到人才供需失衡和 AI 工具普及的双重挤压，执行层价值被压低。高薪机会转向决策层，需要能承担成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力的工程师。适合想评估前端职业空间和技术栈方向的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: The article argues that the era of 30 percent pay raises from job-hopping is over for front-end developers; by 2026 the salary ceiling is squeezed by supply-demand imbalance and AI tools that devalue execution-focused work. Higher-paying roles now go to decision-level engineers who can handle cost optimization, standards, or full-stack work. Good context for developers mapping their front-end career options.

items.summary_zh: 文章用 Three.js 实现了一个简易版电影《牛来》的效果，并附上完整代码和演示效果。作者提到这部据传仅两人主创的电影因“土到极致就是潮”而走红；适合想借热点练习 Three.js 动画的开发者。

The author notes the film is reportedly created by just two people and became popular for its proudly cheesy aesthetics. It's a good starting point for developers learning Three.js through a trending cultural reference.
